name: Snake-Eye Ash 1-Card Combo (Apollousa + Baronne)

steps.note: Normal Summon
Search Snake-Eyes Poplar
Added to hand: Special Summon itself
On summon: search Original Sinful Spoils - Snake-Eye
Link Summon using Snake-Eyes Poplar
Sent to GY: place itself face-up in Spell & Trap Zone
Send Poplar (S/T) to GY, Special Summon Jet Synchron from Deck
Send Ash + Linkuriboh to GY, Special Summon Snake-Eye Oak from Deck
On summon: Special Summon Snake-Eye Ash from GY
Send Oak + Ash to GY, Special Summon Snake-Eyes Flamberge Dragon from Deck
Link Summon using Flamberge Dragon + Jet Synchron
Sent to GY: Special Summon Jet Synchron + Snake-Eye Ash from GY
Synchro Summon using Jet Synchron + Snake-Eye Ash
Draw 1
GY: discard 1 card, Special Summon itself
Link Summon using I:P Masquerena + Jet Synchron
Special Summon Snake-Eyes Flamberge Dragon from GY
Link Summon using Promethean Princess + Formula Synchron; point arrows at key monsters
Special Summon Formula Synchron from GY
Place I:P Masquerena face-up in Spell & Trap Zone
Pass turn
Opp turn: Special Summon I:P Masquerena from S/T Zone
Opp turn: Synchro Summon Baronne de Fleur using Formula Synchron + Flamberge Dragon
Sent to GY: Special Summon Snake-Eye Oak + Snake-Eye Ash
Special Summon Snake-Eyes Poplar from GY
Search a Level 1 FIRE for follow-up
Chain Link 1: tribute a Level 1, Special Summon itself
Chain Link 2: Link Summon on opponent's turn
Chain Link 3: Special Summon Formula Synchron from GY
Link Summon Apollousa, Bow of the Goddess using Masquerena, Formula Synchron + Level 1s, in Spright Elf's protected zone
Place Snake-Eyes Flamberge Dragon face-up in S/T Zone for follow-up

notes: Line 3 from the video (best 1-card combo). The video's transcription was garbled; "Mascarina" = I:P Masquerena, "Baran" = Baronne de Fleur, "Appalissa" = Apollousa, Bow of the Goddess, "Flame Berga" = Snake-Eyes Flamberge Dragon. End: Apollousa (4 monster negates), Baronne (omni-negate), Promethean Princess pop from GY, Linkuriboh to protect Apollousa. Chain on opponent's turn: CL1 Linkuriboh, CL2 Masquerena, CL3 Spright Elf. Put key monsters in Spright Elf's arrow zones. Choke point: Ash Normal Summon/search (Ash Blossom on Ash or Poplar). With Diabellstar the Black Witch as a 2nd card you can add Savage line for an extra omni-negate. Alternative OTK: Divine Temple + Zalantis line for 5 destructions.
